OVERVIEW: Export attachments.

A test identifier can be used to specify a Test Case or a Test Suite. All
attachments will be exported if no test identifier is provided. An additional
manifest.json file will be generated and saved to the output directory. This
file contains a list of attachment details for each test.

Use --schema option to get the output format as JSON Schema. Default schema
version: 0.1.0.

USAGE: xcresulttool export attachments [--test-id <test-id>] [--schema] [--schema-version <schema-version>] --path <path> --output-path <output-path> [--only-failures]

OPTIONS:
  --test-id <test-id>     Test identifier URL or identifier string.
  --schema                Show output format as JSON Schema.
  --schema-version <schema-version>
                          Schema version in major.minor.patch format. Command
                          will return an error if unknown version is passed.
  --path <path>           The result bundle path.
  --output-path <output-path>
                          Output directory path.
  --only-failures         Export only those attachments that are associated
                          with test failures.
  --version               Show the version.
  -h, --help              Show help information.
